agent.apiDescription: Questions are answered from the active structured resume through the AI provider configured in Settings:
agent.nextStep: Treat the answer as guidance and verify every career claim before reuse.
prompts: Which role requirements are directly supported by this resume?
Which achievements provide the strongest evidence of impact?
What transferable experience could bridge a partial match?
Which important requirements are not yet supported?
What should I verify before accepting these changes?

setup.title: Describe your goal and delegate the search once
setup.description: Set your goal, trusted resume, and delegation boundary before launch; the Agent then finds roles, prepares materials, communicates, and follows up.
setup.goalHelp: Use natural language for roles, cities, compensation, work style, and preferences. The Agent converts it into BOSS filters.
setup.goalPlaceholder: Example: Full-time AI Agent or AI full-stack roles in Hangzhou, 35K-60K monthly, remote accepted, TypeScript, React, and RAG preferred; exclude outsourcing.
setup.resumeHelp: Use PDF, DOCX, TXT, or pasted text. Original file bytes are transient extraction inputs and are not persisted.
setup.analysisHelp: These suggestions come only from your resume and do not invent experience.
setup.optionsHelp: These cover the common title, location, salary, experience, education, and company filters found on recruitment sites. Separate multiple values with commas.
setup.delegationHelp: Choose how far the Agent may act. Automatic communication and resume sending stay off unless you select them explicitly.
setup.delegationConsent: I reviewed these choices and authorize the Agent to start with exactly this automation level.
setup.autoSendResume: Automatically send the job-specific PDF after a verified recruiter request
setup.boundarySubmission: Formal submission still requires explicit user confirmation; opening a page is never treated as submitted.
setup.boundaryCaptcha: Login, SMS, QR codes, and CAPTCHAs remain user actions.
setup.boundaryOutcome: The user reports interview pass/fail and final outcomes; predictions remain advisory.

reasons.interview-observed: Interview conversion was observed, allowing a somewhat broader candidate range.
reasons.low-conversion: Historical reply conversion is low, so the simulation raises the filter threshold.
reasons.outcome-observed: Final outcomes were observed and can inform later review parameters.

historyLearning.applied: The simulated history policy was applied; match threshold, daily cap, and automation preferences were updated.
